items.title: 黃仁勳風暴延燒！傳白宮討論是否撤換商務部長盧特尼克
items.title_en: Jensen Huang Storm Continues to Rage! Reports Say White House Discussing Whether to Replace Commerce Secretary Howard Lutnick
paras: 據《路透》周四(12日)引述兩名知情人士報導，白宮高層官員正討論，是否因輝達(NVDA-US)前執行長黃仁勳相關風波，撤換商務部長盧特尼克(Howard Lutnick)。報導未指出已有最終決定，白宮也未立即回應有關其去留的置評要求。
盧特尼克近期面臨愈來愈多國會議員批評，焦點包括政府未將數十家中國企業納入重要貿易黑名單，以及商務部是否妥善監督輝達對中國的晶片出口。
相關質疑早於黃仁勳卸任，但隨著事件持續發酵，盧特尼克被指未充分限制先進AI晶片輸往中國的爭議，也受到更大關注。
據《路透》稍早報導，民主黨議員已要求政府保留輝達先進AI晶片對中出口及相關國安風險的文件。共和黨眾院外交委員會主席馬斯特(Brian Mast)也表示，國會必須調查商務部核准晶片出口的程序，但他仍對盧特尼克有信心。
黃仁勳周四宣布卸任。此前，外媒披露他與黃樂(Alice Huang)的婚外關係，美國當局懷疑黃樂可能替中國從事間諜活動。這場風波也使輝達與川普政府的往來，以及美國對中晶片出口政策，受到更嚴格檢視。
不過，白宮先前針對盧特尼克遭受的批評，仍公開表達支持。一名白宮官員表示，川普「對部長及其履行職務的能力保持完全信任」。
paras_en: According to Reuters on Thursday (the 12th), citing two informed sources, senior White House officials are discussing whether to replace Commerce Secretary Howard Lutnick due to the controversy surrounding former Nvidia (NVDA-US) CEO Jensen Huang. The report did not indicate a final decision had been made, and the White House did not immediately respond to requests for comment on his tenure.

Lutnick has recently faced increasing criticism from members of Congress, focusing on the government's failure to place dozens of Chinese companies on a key trade blacklist and whether the Commerce Department has properly overseen Nvidia's chip exports to China.

The questions arose before Huang's resignation, but as the saga continues to unfold, Lutnick is being accused of not sufficiently restricting the export of advanced AI chips to China, drawing even greater scrutiny.

Earlier Reuters reporting said Democratic lawmakers have asked the government to retain documents related to Nvidia's advanced AI chip exports to China and the associated national security risks. Republican House Foreign Affairs Committee Chairman Brian Mast also said Congress must investigate the Commerce Department's approval process for chip exports, though he still has confidence in Lutnick.

Huang announced his resignation on Thursday. Earlier, foreign media revealed his extramarital affair with Alice Huang, and U.S. authorities suspect Alice Huang may have been conducting espionage for China. The scandal has also led to stricter scrutiny of Nvidia's dealings with the Trump administration and U.S. policy on chip exports to China.

Nevertheless, the White House has continued to publicly back Lutnick against the criticism. One White House official said Trump 'has complete confidence in the secretary and his ability to perform his duties.'

items.title: Fed不想每次開會都牽動市場？華許推新制 明年僅七次利率表決
items.title_en: Fed Doesn't Want Every Meeting to Jolt Markets? Warsh Introduces New System, Only Seven Rate Votes Next Year
paras: 聯準會(Fed)周四(12日)公布2027年會議安排，將把10月26日至27日的聯邦公開市場委員會(FOMC)會議，改為專門討論貨幣政策策略，不進行利率表決，也不發布會後聲明。全年預定進行利率表決的例行會議因此減至七次，最後一次會議則由原訂12月提前至11月。
這項調整是Fed主席華許(Kevin Warsh)改革央行溝通方式的一環，目的是降低Fed對市場的影響，並讓決策官員有更多時間討論長期政策問題。華許在今年10月會後記者會已宣布這項方向，但當時未說明哪一場會議將受到影響。

明年10月不表決利率 留時間討論長期策略

根據Fed公告，2027年10月會議將用於「討論廣泛的貨幣政策策略議題」。這場會議仍會召開，但不安排正式表決，也不發布會後聲明，讓官員能在例行利率決策之外，專注於政策方向與長期挑戰。
華許先前解釋，制定正確政策，需要以適當且規律的頻率，根據充分資訊評估近期發展；但同樣重要的是，決策團隊必須保留時間與空間，讓不同觀點充分交流，重新思考重大問題，並將視野拉向更長期。
他以『聚焦小數點左側』比喻政策討論應著眼重大方向，避免過度糾結細節。
Fed通常每年召開八次例行政策會議，會後公布利率決議，再由主席舉行記者會。新安排並非取消10月會議，而是調整其功能，讓2027年八場會議中的一場，不再承擔即時利率決策任務。

縮短聲明與記者會 華許持續改革Fed溝通

華許過去曾批評Fed的溝通策略，認為官員花費太多時間提供政策走向指引，反而在真正需要決策時，限制自身調整政策的彈性。
自他接掌Fed以來，會後聲明篇幅已大幅縮短，記者會問答時間也從慣常的約45分鐘，縮減至約半小時。調整會議日程，則是他精簡央行溝通的另一項措施。
華許上月並表示，2028年不進行正式表決的會議，預計將增加至兩場，進一步擴大策略討論的空間。
他強調，會議時間與議程安排不只是行政細節，而是一項制度選擇，會影響討論的性質、品質，以及最終決策是否明智。他認為，這是讓貨幣政策運作回到正軌的另一項改革。
FOMC下一次會議將於12月8日至9日舉行，2027年首場會議則訂於1月26日至27日。
paras_en: The Federal Reserve (Fed) on Thursday (the 12th) released its 2027 meeting schedule, converting the Federal Open Market Committee (FOMC) meeting on October 26‑27 into a session dedicated solely to discussing monetary‑policy strategy, with no rate vote and no post‑meeting statement. As a result, the number of regular meetings with rate votes for the year is cut to seven, and the final meeting is moved up from December to November.

This adjustment is part of Fed Chair Kevin Warsh's effort to reform the central bank's communication approach, aimed at reducing the Fed's impact on markets and giving policymakers more time to discuss long‑term policy issues. Warsh announced this direction at the October press conference this year, but did not specify which meeting would be affected at that time.

No Rate Vote in October Next Year, Time Set Aside for Long‑Term Strategy
According to the Fed's announcement, the October 2027 meeting will be used to “discuss a broad range of monetary‑policy strategy topics.” The meeting will still be held, but no formal vote or post‑meeting statement will be issued, allowing officials to focus on policy direction and long‑term challenges outside the routine rate‑setting process.

Warsh previously explained that crafting the right policy requires evaluating recent developments at an appropriate and regular frequency based on sufficient information; equally important is that the decision‑making team retain time and space for diverse viewpoints to be fully exchanged, to rethink major issues, and to broaden the outlook toward the longer term.
He used the metaphor of “focusing on the left side of the decimal point” to illustrate that policy discussions should concentrate on major directions rather than getting bogged down in minutiae.

The Fed normally holds eight regular policy meetings each year, publishing a rate decision afterward and holding a press conference by the chair. The new arrangement does not cancel the October meeting but changes its function, making one of the eight 2027 meetings no longer responsible for an immediate rate decision.

Shortening Statements and Press Conferences, Warsh Continues Fed Communication Reform
Warsh has previously criticized the Fed's communication strategy, arguing that officials spend too much time providing guidance on policy direction, which can limit their flexibility to adjust policy when real decisions are needed.

Since he took the helm, the length of post‑meeting statements has been dramatically reduced, and the press‑conference Q&A time has been cut from the usual roughly 45 minutes to about half an hour. Adjusting the meeting calendar is another measure in his effort to streamline central‑bank communication.
Warsh said last month that the number of meetings in 2028 without a formal vote is expected to increase to two, further expanding the space for strategic discussion.

He emphasized that meeting timing and agenda are not merely administrative details but a institutional choice that affects the nature and quality of discussions and whether the final decisions are wise. He sees this as another reform to get monetary‑policy operations back on track.
The next FOMC meeting will be held on December 8‑9, and the first 2027 meeting is scheduled for January 26‑27.

items.title: 黃仁勳卸任後再爆新調查！美方追查黃樂與美超微產品走私關聯
items.title_en: New Investigation After Jensen Huang Steps Down! U.S. Probes Alice Huang’s Ties to SMIC Product Smuggling
paras: 據《彭博》周四(12日)引述知情人士報導，美國司法部正調查黃樂(Alice Huang)相關實體，是否涉及將美超微(SMCI-US)產品走私至中國。黃樂因與輝達(NVDA-US)前執行長黃仁勳的關係受到關注，美方官員懷疑她可能從事間諜活動，如今檢方也正追查她與伺服器走私活動的潛在關聯。
這項先前未曝光的調查由曼哈頓聯邦檢察官辦公室主導。目前尚不清楚，是否與美國或亞洲已起訴的晶片走私案件直接相關，也不清楚黃樂或相關實體可能扮演何種角色。
消息傳出後，美超微(SMCI-US)周四盤中股價重挫，截稿前下跌11.17%，每股暫報27.03美元。

調查涉及美超微產品 與既有走私案關聯待釐清

司法部先前已針對黃樂曾任職的Megaspeed International展開涉嫌半導體走私調查，該公司否認不當行為。美超微、司法部及曼哈頓聯邦檢察官辦公室，均拒絕評論這次涉及黃樂的調查。
已遭起訴的相關案件中，最受矚目的是美超微共同創辦人廖益賢(Wally Liaw)與另外兩人，今年3月被曼哈頓聯邦檢方指控，涉嫌將搭載輝達晶片的伺服器運往一家東南亞公司，再轉送中國客戶。
廖益賢已不在美超微任職，並對指控表示不認罪。美超微未被列為被告，公司表示正配合調查。
《彭博》先前報導，起訴書未具名的東南亞公司是位於曼谷的OBON，該公司未回應置評要求。美國檢方另指，兩名未具名的第三方仲介，也參與將伺服器轉送中國的安排。
不過，現階段尚未確認黃樂與上述案件有直接關聯。司法部調查也可能在未提出任何指控的情況下結束。

另涉間諜調查 黃仁勳目前並非調查對象

知情人士表示，司法部也正進行涉及黃樂的間諜調查，包括檢視她與黃仁勳的關係；黃仁勳目前並非美國執法機關的調查對象。
據《彭博》報導，黃樂目前居住北京，中國安全官員知悉此事，媒體未能聯繫上她。她透過輝達在東南亞最大的晶片買家Megaspeed，與黃仁勳建立往來，兩人並無親屬關係。
黃仁勳周日承認婚外情後，輝達陷入危機、股價重挫，並於周四(12日)宣布他卸任。中國則駁斥相關間諜指控，稱其為「抹黑」。隨著川普與習近平即將會面，這起事件也可能成為美中關係的新摩擦點。
美超微執行長梁見後3月曾在公開信中表示，公司已對所有已確認身分的涉案員工採取行動，相關人士與公司已無關係，廖益賢也已辭去董事職務。公司8月另表示，獨立調查發現，現任高階管理層並不知悉涉嫌走私的安排。
paras_en: According to Bloomberg on Thursday the 12th, citing sources, the U.S. Department of Justice is investigating entities linked to Alice Huang to determine whether they were involved in smuggling SMIC (SMCI-US) products to China. Huang has drawn attention due to her relationship with former Nvidia (NVDA-US) CEO Jensen Huang, and U.S. officials suspect she may have engaged in espionage; prosecutors are now also probing any potential connection between her and server smuggling activities.

The previously undisclosed probe is being led by the Manhattan U.S. Attorney’s Office. It is not yet clear whether it is directly related to chip‑smuggling cases already filed in the United States or Asia, nor what role Huang or the associated entities might have played.
After the news broke, SMIC’s intraday share price plunged on Thursday, down 11.17% before the close, trading at roughly $27.03 per share.

The investigation concerns SMIC products and how they may be linked to existing smuggling cases. The Justice Department had earlier opened a semiconductor‑smuggling inquiry into Megaspeed International, a firm where Huang previously worked, which has denied any wrongdoing. SMIC, the Justice Department and the Manhattan U.S. Attorney’s Office all declined to comment on the current probe involving Huang.

Among the cases already charged, the most prominent involves SMIC co‑founder Wally Liaw and two others, who in March were indicted by Manhattan federal prosecutors for allegedly shipping servers equipped with Nvidia chips to a Southeast Asian company that then forwarded them to a Chinese customer.
Liaw is no longer employed by SMIC and has pleaded not guilty to the charges. SMIC is not named as a defendant and says it is cooperating with the investigation.

Bloomberg previously reported that the unnamed Southeast Asian firm is OBON, based in Bangkok, which did not respond to requests for comment. U.S. prosecutors also allege that two unnamed third‑party intermediaries helped arrange the transfer of the servers to China.
However, at this stage there is no confirmation that Huang is directly linked to the aforementioned case. The Justice Department’s inquiry could conclude without any charges being filed.

The probe also touches on espionage concerns. Sources say the Justice Department is examining possible spy activity involving Huang, including her relationship with Jensen Huang, though Jensen Huang is not currently a target of any U.S. law‑enforcement investigation.

Bloomberg reports that Huang now resides in Beijing, where Chinese security officials are aware of the matter, but media outlets have been unable to reach her. She connected with Jensen Huang through Megaspeed, the largest chip buyer for Nvidia in Southeast Asia, and the two are not related by blood.

After Jensen Huang admitted to an extramarital affair on Sunday, Nvidia faced a crisis and a sharp stock decline, and he announced his resignation on Thursday the 12th. China has rejected the espionage allegations as “smear,” and with a Trump‑Xi summit on the horizon, the episode could become a new flashpoint in U.S.–China relations.

SMIC CEO Liang Jianhou said in a March open letter that the company had taken action against all employees whose identities had been confirmed in the case and that those individuals were no longer associated with the firm; Liaw has also stepped down from the board. In August the company said an independent review found that current senior management was unaware of the alleged smuggling scheme.

items.title: 輝達風險不只在股價！4000億美元承諾如何牽動AI資金鏈
items.title_en: Nvidia's Risk Extends Beyond Its Stock Price! How a $400 Billion Commitment Ties the AI Funding Chain
paras: 黃仁勳卸任輝達(NVDA-US)執行長，市場關注的不只是接班與股價，還有這家晶片龍頭支撐AI產業的龐大融資網絡。據《CNBC》分析，輝達透過雲端採購、專案擔保等安排協助客戶擴張，相關承諾經學者估計約達4,000億美元；若產業景氣逆轉，影響可能延伸至銀行與信用市場。
聯準會(Fed)及其他金融機構正密切關注AI投資熱潮。Fed官員早在7月便討論過，AI產業若出現問題，可能引發廣泛的資產重新定價。不過，受訪專家普遍認為，這不代表2008年金融海嘯即將重演。

從採購到擔保 輝達如何支撐AI融資

輝達不只是供應晶片，也協助客戶取得資金。公司7月揭露，承諾向新興AI雲端業者採購最高360億美元服務。這些業者使用輝達晶片建置資料中心，再出租運算能力；有了大客戶的採購承諾，便更容易取得融資。
其他安排包括，在特定條件下，為OpenAI與SB Energy規劃的俄亥俄州資料中心專案提供1,050億美元分階段擔保，以及替華爾街金融機構的5,000億美元信貸方案，提供最高1,250億美元支持。
哥倫比亞商學院財務教授Stijn Van Nieuwerburgh估計，輝達整體承諾約達4,000億美元。這些安排形式不同，並非全是公司已借入的債務，也不太可能同時到期，部分甚至未必需要實際履行。
國際貨幣基金(IMF)官員Jason Wu將這類安排稱為「循環融資」。景氣擴張時，大企業協助客戶採購產品，可以帶動成長；但若支持承諾無法履行，壓力便可能傳向借款企業與放款機構。

GPU跌價恐牽動信用風險 專家仍看見緩衝

監管機構擔心的是，多項支撐AI繁榮的因素同時逆轉。例如，若GPU價值下跌，投資人可能質疑借錢購買晶片的業者能否償債，科技公司便可能同時面臨股價下跌與信用損失。
部分市場指標已反映壓力。據LSEG資料，CoreWeave(CRWV-US)信用違約交換利差從10月1日至11月5日擴大94%，之後才趨穩；IREN(IREN-US)一筆2029年到期可轉債，則在11月3日至5日下跌23%。
Wu指出，經濟與金融市場若同樣仰賴AI成長，一旦下滑，衝擊可能相互強化。大量投入AI融資、透明度相對有限的私人信貸基金，也是監管關注對象。
不過，前美國聯邦存款保險公司主席貝爾(Sheila Bair)認為，輝達與銀行不同，不會以相同方式面臨信心流失引發的擠兌，且仍生產客戶需要的產品。
Van Nieuwerburgh也指出，產業仍有龐大股權資本作為緩衝，競爭業者發展替代晶片，長期可能減輕單一公司出問題的經濟衝擊。眼前關鍵在於，輝達的個別風波是否演變成客戶償債與金融機構放款品質惡化，而不只是股價修正。
paras_en: Jensen Huang stepped down as CEO of Nvidia (NVDA-US), and the market’s focus is not only on his successor and the share price but also on the massive financing network this chip leader provides to the AI industry. CNBC analysis estimates Nvidia’s commitments—through cloud procurement, project guarantees and other arrangements that help customers expand—total roughly $400 billion; a downturn in the sector could ripple through banks and credit markets.

The Federal Reserve and other financial institutions are closely monitoring the AI investment boom. Fed officials discussed as early as July that problems in the AI sector could trigger widespread asset repricing, though interviewed experts generally say this does not signal a repeat of the 2008 financial crisis.

From Procurement to Guarantees: How Nvidia Supports AI Financing
Nvidia does more than supply chips; it helps customers secure funding. In July the company disclosed a commitment to purchase up to $36 billion of services from emerging AI cloud providers. These providers use Nvidia chips to build data centers and then lease compute capacity; a large customer procurement pledge makes it easier for them to obtain financing.

Other arrangements include, under certain conditions, a phased $105 billion guarantee for the Ohio data‑center project planned by OpenAI and SB Energy, and a $500 billion credit program for Wall Street financial institutions, providing up to $125 billion of support.

Columbia Business School finance professor Stijn Van Nieuwerburgh estimates Nvidia’s total commitments at about $400 billion. The arrangements take various forms, are not all debt that the company has already borrowed, are unlikely to mature simultaneously, and some may never need to be fulfilled.

International Monetary Fund official Jason Wu calls these arrangements “circular financing.” In periods of expansion, large firms help customers purchase products, spurring growth; but if the support commitments cannot be met, pressure could flow back to borrowing firms and lenders.

Regulators worry that multiple pillars supporting AI prosperity could reverse at once. For example, a drop in GPU prices might lead investors to question whether firms that borrowed to buy chips can repay, potentially causing tech companies to face both falling stock prices and credit losses.

Some market indicators already show stress. LSEG data show CoreWeave’s (CRWV-US) credit‑default swap spread widened 94% from Oct 1 to Nov 5 before stabilising; IREN’s (IREN-US) 2029 convertible bond fell 23% between Nov 3 and 5.

Wu notes that if both the real economy and financial markets rely on AI growth, a slowdown could amplify shocks. Massive AI financing and relatively opaque private‑credit funds are also on regulators’ radar.
However, former FDIC chair Sheila Bair argues that Nvidia differs from banks and will not face a run‑on of confidence in the same way, and it continues to produce products that customers need.

Van Nieuwerburgh also points out that the industry still has substantial equity capital as a buffer, and competitors developing alternative chips could, over the long term, lessen the economic impact of a problem at any single company. The immediate question is whether Nvidia’s individual issues could turn into customer defaults and deteriorating loan quality for financial institutions, rather than merely a stock‑price correction.

items.title: 輝達新加坡百億美元營收一夕消失！WSJ曝財報揭露方式突變更 Megaspeed疑雲再升高
items.title_en: Nvidia's $10 Billion Singapore Revenue Vanishes Overnight! WSJ Reveals Sudden Change in Reporting Raises Megaspeed Cloud Doubts
paras: 輝達(NVDA-US)執行長黃仁勳日前坦承美方認定與中國間諜的Megaspeed高階主管黃樂(Alice Huang)有婚外情，讓這家總部位於新加坡的雲端運算公司成為整起醜聞的核心。《華爾街日報》(WSJ)評論指出，雖然新加坡直到去年夏天還是輝達最大市場之一，但從去年夏天起，輝達就不再公布新加坡營收，時間點引人疑竇。
黃樂曾是Megaspeed高階主管，美國政府懷疑她為中國情報機構工作。輝達發言人本周表示，公司已在2025年6月將Megaspeed列入「封鎖名單」，禁止後續銷售或出貨，這項自願停止交易的措施至今仍然有效。
WSJ披露，輝達把Megaspeed列入內部封鎖名單不久後，便調整按地區揭露營收的方式。雖然目前不清楚這項調整是否和外遇醜聞直接相關，但變更之後，投資人無法再掌握輝達與新加坡相關的銷售情況。
輝達董事會本周稍早表示，正在調查有關黃仁勳「成為外國情報行動目標」的報導，黃仁勳則在致員工信中道歉，坦承對妻子不忠。
不過外遇風波還沒完，《紐約時報》周三爆出黃仁勳另一起婚外情，對象為公司直屬女下屬，這已觸犯輝達行為準則中嚴禁「個人關係引發利益衝突」的規範。WSJ也在約莫同一時間報導，輝達董事會正準備最快周三開會撤換黃仁勳。
WSJ專欄作家Jonathan Weil認為，無論黃仁勳是否仍繼續擔任執行長，投資人有權知道原因新加坡營收一夕消失的原因，輝達也有必要提供官方解釋。

Megaspeed遭輝達列入封鎖名單 新加坡曾占營收22%

輝達最後一次揭露與新加坡相關營收，是截至2025年7月的會計年度季度，也就是實施封鎖措施的次月。輝達當時表示，新加坡營收較去年同期成長81%至102億美元，占公司總營收22%。兩年前，新加坡僅占輝達營收的8%。
到了下一季、也就是截至2025年10月的一季，輝達便更改了營收揭露方式，開始依據「客戶總部所在地」揭露地區營收，而不再採用過去的「客戶帳單所在地」。
去年夏天，也正是美國政府密切調查受出口管制的人工智慧(AI)晶片，是否透過海外中間商轉運至中國。
根據原本的揭露方式，輝達將營收分為美國、新加坡、台灣、中國(包括香港)，以及「其他地區」。改採新方式後，輝達不再單獨揭露新加坡營收，但其他地理區域仍維持不變。
從重新編列過去財報數據的資料來看，輝達把原本大部分以新加坡為帳單所在地的營收，重新歸類為美國相關營收，同時調高中國及台灣的營收數字。
不過，目前仍不清楚為何這項變更會讓新加坡從地區營收分布中消失。輝達也沒有說明，無論採用新舊哪一種揭露方式，與Megaspeed相關的營收究竟被歸入哪個類別。
針對這些銷售在新舊揭露制度下分別被歸入哪個地區，以及停止單獨揭露新加坡營收是否與公司切斷和Megaspeed的交易有關等問題，輝達發言人Patrick Rutherford拒絕回答。

改採總部所在地計算 投資人難以追蹤晶片銷售去向

WSJ專欄作家Weil指出，讓財務資訊更加不透明的是，許多買家購買輝達硬體時，取得的是由美國企業組裝、整合在伺服器系統中的產品，例如戴爾(DELL-US)或美超微電腦(Super Micro Computer)(SMCI-US)。
無論採用哪一種揭露方式，輝達是否都在不考慮產品最終去向的情況下通通列入美國營收，也是公司尚未回答的諸多問題之一。
Weil表示，如果輝達當時沒有改變營收揭露方式，而新加坡帳單所在地營收突然大幅下滑，可能引起投資人。假如切斷與Megaspeed的交易是營收下滑的原因，黃仁勳也可能面臨難以回答的問題。
反過來說，如果新加坡銷售額一直保持在高檔，也可能讓外界質疑輝達出口管制措施的成效。
Weil特別強調，從輝達財報資料無法得知，2025年10月季度及之後的新加坡營收原本會呈現何種樣貌，畢竟輝達從未說明與Megaspeed相關的銷售究竟如何歸類。但可以確定的是，這項揭露方式的改變，讓投資人更難比較輝達封鎖Megaspeed前後的營收狀況。
在2025年10月為止的季度財報中，輝達表示這項財務揭露變更「能更準確呈現我們營收的地理分布」。
但Weil認為，這個解釋存在一大漏洞。
輝達表示，客戶帳單所在地「經常反映客戶集中開立發票的地點，儘管(晶片)實際上幾乎總是運往其他地方」。然而，客戶總部所在地同樣無法反映晶片實際出貨地點。
換句話說，無論採用帳單地址還是總部地址，都無法真正回答晶片最後去向。更重要的是，改制過後，新加坡營收就從財報中消失了，一切就發生在輝達與Megaspeed的關係暗中受到愈來愈嚴格檢視之際。
隨著輝達開始收拾這場醜聞造成的後續問題，Weil認為該公司有責任向外界完整交代晶片銷售過去流向何處，如今又流向何處。
paras_en: Nvidia (NVDA-US) CEO Jensen Huang recently admitted that the U.S. has identified a relationship between China‑spying Megaspeed senior executive Alice Huang and an extramarital affair, making the Singapore‑based cloud computing company the centre of the scandal. The Wall Street Journal (WSJ) noted that although Singapore was one of Nvidia’s biggest markets until last summer, Nvidia stopped reporting Singapore revenue after that summer, a timing that raises suspicion.

Alice Huang was a senior executive at Megaspeed, and the U.S. government suspects she works for Chinese intelligence. Nvidia’s spokesperson said this week that the company placed Megaspeed on a "blocked list" in June 2025, prohibiting any further sales or shipments, and that the voluntary halt remains in effect.

The WSJ disclosed that shortly after Nvidia added Megaspeed to its internal blocked list, it changed the way it reports revenue by region. It is unclear whether the change is directly tied to the affair scandal, but after the change investors can no longer see Nvidia’s sales related to Singapore.

Nvidia’s board said earlier this week that it is investigating reports that Jensen Huang has become a target of foreign intelligence operations. Huang apologized to employees in a letter, admitting infidelity to his wife.

The affair saga is not over. The New York Times reported on Wednesday that Huang is involved in another extramarital relationship with a direct female subordinate, violating Nvidia’s code that strictly forbids personal relationships that create conflicts of interest. The WSJ reported around the same time that the board is preparing to meet as early as Wednesday to consider removing Huang.
WSJ columnist Jonathan Weil argued that whether or not Huang remains CEO, investors have a right to know why Singapore revenue vanished overnight, and Nvidia should provide an official explanation.

Megaspeed was placed on Nvidia’s blocked list; Singapore once accounted for 22% of revenue. Nvidia’s last disclosed Singapore‑related revenue was for the fiscal quarter ending July 2025, the month after the block was imposed. At that time Nvidia said Singapore revenue grew 81% year‑over‑year to $10.2 billion, representing 22% of total revenue. Two years earlier Singapore contributed only 8% of Nvidia’s revenue.

In the following quarter, ending October 2025, Nvidia altered its revenue disclosure method, switching to reporting by "customer headquarters location" instead of the previous "customer billing location."
Last summer was also when the U.S. government was closely investigating whether AI chips under export controls were being routed to China through overseas intermediaries.

Under the old disclosure method Nvidia broke revenue into United States, Singapore, Taiwan, China (including Hong Kong), and "other regions." After the switch, Nvidia stopped reporting Singapore separately, while the other geographic categories remained unchanged.

A review of re‑compiled historical financial data shows Nvidia re‑classifying most of the revenue that had previously been billed to Singapore as U.S.‑related revenue, while inflating the figures for China and Taiwan.

It is still unclear why the change caused Singapore to disappear from the regional revenue breakdown. Nvidia has not explained which category Megaspeed‑related sales now fall under under either the old or new reporting scheme.

When asked which region these sales would be assigned to under the old versus new disclosure regimes, and whether the cessation of separate Singapore reporting is linked to cutting off transactions with Megaspeed, Nvidia spokesperson Patrick Rutherford declined to comment.

Switching to a headquarters‑based calculation makes it harder for investors to track where chips are sold, Weil noted. Adding to the opacity, many buyers receive Nvidia hardware that is assembled and integrated into server systems by U.S. companies such as Dell (DELL-US) or Super Micro Computer (SMCI-US).
Regardless of the reporting method, whether Nvidia lumps all sales into U.S. revenue without considering the final destination of the product is one of the many unanswered questions.

Weil said that if Nvidia had not changed its reporting method and Singapore‑billed revenue suddenly dropped sharply, investors would likely be alarmed. If the cut‑off with Megaspeed caused the decline, Huang could face difficult questions.
Conversely, if Singapore sales remained high, it could lead outsiders to question the effectiveness of Nvidia’s export‑control measures.

Weil emphasized that from Nvidia’s financial statements it is impossible to know what Singapore revenue would have looked like in the Q4 2025 quarter and beyond, because Nvidia never disclosed how Megaspeed‑related sales are classified. What is clear is that the reporting change makes it harder for investors to compare Nvidia’s revenue before and after the Megaspeed block.
In its Q4 2025 quarterly report Nvidia stated that the financial‑reporting change "allows a more accurate representation of the geographic distribution of our revenue."
Weil believes that explanation contains a major flaw.

Nvidia says the customer‑billing location "often reflects where the customer consolidates invoicing, even though the chips are almost always shipped elsewhere." However, the customer‑headquarters location also fails to reflect the actual shipment destination of the chips.

In other words, whether using billing address or headquarters address, neither method truly reveals where the chips end up. More importantly, after the change Singapore revenue vanished from the filings just as Nvidia’s relationship with Megaspeed came under increasingly strict scrutiny.
As Nvidia works to clean up the fallout from the scandal, Weil argues the company has a responsibility to fully disclose where its chips have been sold in the past and where they are going now.

items.title: 卸任還沒完！黃仁勳同意赴美國會作證 晶片出口爭議成焦點
items.title_en: Resignation Not Over Yet! Jensen Huang Agrees to Testify Before Congress, Chip Export Dispute Becomes Focal Point
paras: 據《彭博》報導，美國眾議院外交委員會主席馬斯特(Brian Mast)周四(12日)表示，剛卸任輝達(NVDA-US)執行長的黃仁勳，已同意赴國會作證，預計將於本月感恩節假期前宣誓接受詢問。這意味著黃仁勳離開公司領導職位後，仍須面對國會對相關爭議的追查。
馬斯特在國會山莊向記者表示，數名重量級議員先前揚言，若黃仁勳不願出席，將對他發出傳票；黃仁勳已於周三晚間同意作證。目前尚未公布確切日期，作證可能採閉門形式，馬斯特則預期過程將錄影，並製作逐字紀錄。
此次詢問將由眾院外交委員會、對中事務特別委員會及情報委員會共同參與。黃仁勳與一名疑涉中國情報活動女子的婚外關係曝光後，輝達的對中晶片銷售與出口管制問題，也受到華府更嚴格的檢視。
馬斯特說：「各位知道，我與黃仁勳在出口管制問題上一直有很大的分歧，但輝達對美國而言是一家非常重要的公司。」
他接著表示：「我不希望輝達受到任何傷害，但他有一些非常嚴肅的問題必須回答。」
輝達周四宣布黃仁勳卸任，由財務長克瑞斯(Colette Kress)暫代執行長。隨著黃仁勳同意作證，這場風波的焦點也將進一步轉向國會調查，以及他如何回應議員對出口管制等議題的質疑。
paras_en: According to Bloomberg, Brian Mast, chairman of the House Foreign Affairs Committee, said on Thursday (the 12th) that Jensen Huang, who has just stepped down as CEO of Nvidia (NVDA-US), has agreed to appear before Congress and is expected to be sworn in for questioning before the Thanksgiving holiday this month. This means that even after leaving his leadership role at the company, Huang will still have to face congressional scrutiny of the related controversies.

Mast told reporters on Capitol Hill that several heavyweight lawmakers had previously warned they would issue a subpoena if Huang refused to appear; Huang agreed to testify on Wednesday night. No exact date has been announced yet, the testimony may be held behind closed doors, and Mast expects the proceedings to be recorded on video and transcribed verbatim.

The questioning will involve the House Foreign Affairs Committee, the Select Committee on the Chinese Communist Party, and the Intelligence Committee. After revelations of an extramarital affair between Huang and a woman suspected of involvement in Chinese intelligence activities, Nvidia’s sales of chips to China and its export‑control issues have come under even stricter scrutiny from Washington.
Mast said, “You know, I have had major disagreements with Jensen Huang over export‑control issues, but Nvidia is a very important company for the United States.”
He added, “I don’t want Nvidia to be harmed in any way, but there are some very serious questions that he must answer.”

Nvidia announced on Thursday that Huang has stepped down, with CFO Colette Kress temporarily assuming the CEO role. With Huang’s agreement to testify, the spotlight of the controversy will shift further to the congressional investigation and how he responds to lawmakers’ questions on export controls and related topics.

items.title: 黃仁勳辭職後管制恐再收緊！美眾院議長：對中國晶片出口限制共識升溫
items.title_en: After Jensen Huang Steps Down, Chip Export Controls May Tighten Again! House Speaker Says Consensus on China Chip Export Restrictions Is Heating Up
paras: 輝達(NVDA-US)宣布黃仁勳辭任執行長後，美國對中晶片出口政策再度受到關注。美國眾議院議長強生(Mike Johnson)周四(12日)表示，國會對限制半導體晶片出口至中國，正逐漸形成共識，近期事件可能促使更多議員改變立場。
據《路透》報導，強生向記者表示，對中晶片出口管制一直是國會的重要議題，他本人支持限制相關出口，也認為國會正逐步凝聚共識，將此視為重要政策立場。
強生說：「尤其考量最近的事態發展，這樣做是有道理的。」他接著表示：「我們會看看接下來如何發展。我認為這可能改變一些人的想法。」
這番談話出現在輝達宣布黃仁勳離任之際。黃仁勳與中國商界人士黃樂(Alice Huang)的婚外情遭媒體披露後，持續面臨壓力。美國當局懷疑黃樂替北京從事情報工作，她曾擔任輝達雲端合作夥伴Megaspeed的高階主管。
華府也懷疑Megaspeed協助中國取得受美國出口管制限制的先進AI晶片，使這場風波進一步延伸至晶片流向與管制執行問題。
除了出口政策，國會也持續要求黃仁勳出面說明。眾院外交委員會主席馬斯特(Brian Mast)周四表示，國會幕僚已於周三晚間與輝達團隊交談，他預期黃仁勳將在未來一周內向國會作證。
馬斯特與另外兩名眾院共和黨高層上周已要求黃仁勳，就其與黃樂的關係進行閉門簡報。不過，馬斯特此次說法仍是對作證時間的預期；強生所稱的出口限制共識，也不代表國會已通過新的管制措施。
paras_en: Nvidia (NVDA-US) announced that Jensen Huang has resigned as CEO, bringing renewed attention to U.S. policy on exporting chips to China. House Speaker Mike Johnson said on Thursday (the 12th) that Congress is gradually reaching a consensus on limiting semiconductor chip exports to China, and recent events could sway more lawmakers to change their stance.

According to Reuters, Johnson told reporters that chip export controls to China have long been a major congressional issue. He personally supports restricting such exports and believes Congress is steadily coalescing around this as a key policy position.
Johnson said, "Especially given recent developments, it makes sense to act that way." He added, "We’ll see how things unfold. I think this could change some people's thinking."

The comments came as Nvidia announced Huang’s departure. Huang has been under pressure after media reports revealed an extramarital affair with Chinese businesswoman Alice Huang. U.S. authorities suspect Alice Huang of conducting intelligence work for Beijing; she previously held a senior role at Nvidia’s cloud partner Megaspeed.

The administration also suspects Megaspeed of helping China obtain advanced AI chips that are subject to U.S. export restrictions, extending the controversy to issues of chip flow and enforcement of controls.

Beyond export policy, Congress continues to press Jensen Huang for explanations. House Foreign Affairs Committee Chairman Brian Mast said on Thursday that congressional staff spoke with Nvidia’s team on Wednesday night and he expects Huang to testify before Congress within the next week.

Mast and two other senior House Republicans had asked Huang last week to give a closed‑door briefing on his relationship with Alice Huang. However, Mast’s current remarks only address the timing of the testimony; Johnson’s talk of a consensus on export restrictions does not mean Congress has passed new control measures.

items.title: 黃仁勳閃辭！川普建議庫克接輝達執行長
items.title_en: Jensen Huang Resigns! Trump Suggests Cook Take Over Nvidia CEO
paras: 人工智慧晶片大廠輝達（Nvidia）(NVDA-US) 執行長黃仁勳閃辭後，美國總統川普12日（周四）表示，蘋果(AAPL-US) 前執行長庫克應接替黃仁勳，擔任輝達執行長。
川普表示，「輝達執行長黃仁勳的表現出色，但他現已辭職，唯一能接替他的人選只有蘋果執行董事長庫克。」
輝達12日宣布，董事會已批准黃仁勳辭去總裁、執行長及董事職務，即刻生效。
輝達現任執行副總裁兼財務長科萊特·克雷斯（Colette Kress）出任臨時執行長，並繼續擔任財務長，直至正式繼任者確定。
輝達董事會將啟動新任執行長遴選程序，同時考慮內部及外部候選人。
此外，輝達表示，將於太平洋時間11月17日下午1時20分左右公布2027年度第三季財報，並於下午2時召開財報電話會議，相關安排維持不變。
paras_en: After AI chip giant Nvidia (NVDA-US) CEO Jensen Huang abruptly resigned, U.S. President Trump said on Thursday the former Apple (AAPL-US) CEO Tim Cook should replace Huang as Nvidia’s chief executive.
Trump said, “Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang performed excellently, but he has now resigned, and the only person who can replace him is Apple chairman Tim Cook.”
Nvidia announced on the 12th that its board has approved Jensen Huang’s resignation from the roles of president, chief executive and director, effective immediately.
Nvidia’s current executive vice president and chief financial officer Colette Kress will serve as interim CEO while continuing as CFO until a permanent successor is named.
The Nvidia board will launch a search process for a new CEO, considering both internal and external candidates.
Nvidia also said it will release its fiscal 2027 third‑quarter earnings around 1:20 p.m. PT on November 17 and hold a earnings call at 2 p.m., with the schedule unchanged.

items.title: 韋僑(6417) 毛利率連三季守 34%！2027 年 IC 漲價如何轉嫁？
items.title_en: Wei Chiao (6417) Gross Margin Holds Above 34% for Three Quarters! How Will 2027 IC Price Hikes Be Passed On?
paras: 2026年11月13日（優分析／產業數據中心報導）⸺ 韋僑(6417-TW) 前 3 季毛利率 34.55%、較去年同期增加 3.59 個百分點，第 3 季單季 34.38%，連三季維持在 34% 以上。公司將此水準歸因於台中新廠的規模攤提與產品組合；2027 年 IC 廠將漲價，毛利率能否維持，公司表示取決於客戶是否接受成本轉嫁。
新廠是支撐毛利率的首要因素。這座廠當初設計的年產能是 30 億元，公司目前的營業額規模是 18 億元至 20 億元。公司表示新廠自動化程度高，許多設備由公司自行開發，營業額擴大有助攤提固定成本，較有利於維持毛利率。
產品組合是第二個變數，硬式標籤（tag）指卡片、hard tag 與 keyfob 這類產品，前 3 季占 68%；軟性標籤（label）貼在包裝與醫療耗材上，占 31%，其他 1%。第 3 季毛利率比第 2 季的 34.71% 減少 0.33 個百分點，公司歸因於組合差異。
毛利率從 2025 年第 3 季的 29.35% 起回升，2026 年第 1 季到第 3 季都在 34% 以上；營業額則從 2025 年第 3 季的 4.05 億元升到 2026 年第 3 季的 5.10 億元，規模效益反映在毛利率水準上。
漲價與轉嫁2027 年將面臨成本壓力。公司指出，台積電已宣布 2027 年將調漲價格，IC 廠成本隨之上升，漲價壓力將經由 IC 傳導至標籤成本；產品用到的 PCB 板也在漲價，兩項都將推升成本，能否因應取決於「怎麼去把這些漲價有能力轉嫁給我的客戶」。
成本能否轉嫁，取決於客戶結構，韋僑的客戶結構偏向醫療。公司表示，醫療客戶較願意了解成本結構，也願意在合理時機反映成本變化，「越是醫療客戶它比較會接受你給它看到這些東西」；公司指出，醫療客戶不會因小幅價差，更換共同開發產品的合作夥伴。
公司對工廠的期許是「維持 30 % 以上的毛利率」，仰賴生產效率與適時轉嫁成本，工廠管理是公司自己的責任。
如下圖，根據優分析產業資料庫，毛利率 2026 年第 1 季 34.57%、第 2 季 34.71%、第 3 季 34.38%，三季都在 34% 以上，第 2 季是此期間的高點，圖中資料截至 2026 年第 3 季。
（資料來源：優分析產業資料庫）
客戶目前仍願意接受漲價轉嫁。公司表示，IC 漲價並非僅韋僑面臨的問題，「IC 漲價問題你去找誰都一樣」，客戶清楚這一點。工廠端則須進一步提升生產效率，公司認為目前的困難仍可因應。

paras_en: On November 13, 2026 (reported by You Analysis/Industry Data Center), Wei Chiao (6417‑TW) posted a gross margin of 34.55% for the first three quarters, up 3.59 percentage points year‑over‑year, with Q3 at 34.38%, keeping the margin above 34% for three consecutive quarters. The company attributes this level to scale amortization from its new plant in Taichung and its product mix; whether the margin can be maintained when IC factories raise prices in 2027 depends on customers’ willingness to absorb the cost pass‑through.

The new plant is the primary driver of the margin. Designed for an annual capacity of NT$3 billion, the plant now supports a revenue scale of roughly NT$1.8‑2 billion. The company says the plant is highly automated, with many pieces of equipment developed in‑house, so expanding revenue helps spread fixed costs and better sustain the margin.

Product mix is the second variable. Hard tags – such as cards, hard tags and keyfobs – accounted for 68% of sales in the first three quarters; soft labels applied to packaging and medical consumables made up 31%, with the remaining 1% in other categories. The Q3 margin fell 0.33 percentage points from Q2’s 34.71%, which the company attributes to the mix shift.

The margin has been climbing since Q3 2025’s 29.35%, staying above 34% from Q1 through Q3 2026. Revenue rose from NT$405 million in Q3 2025 to NT$510 million in Q3 2026, reflecting scale benefits that are reflected in the margin level.

Pricing pressure and cost pass‑through will intensify in 2027. The company notes that TSMC has announced a price increase for 2027, raising IC factory costs, which will flow through to label costs. PCB boards used in the products are also seeing price hikes, and the ability to respond hinges on “how we can effectively pass these price increases onto our customers.”

Whether costs can be passed on depends on the customer base, which leans toward medical clients. The firm says medical customers are more willing to understand cost structures and to reflect cost changes at appropriate times – “the more medical the customer, the more likely they are to accept what you show them.” It also points out that medical clients won’t switch co‑development partners over small price differences.
The company’s target for the plant is to “maintain a gross margin above 30%,” relying on production efficiency and timely cost pass‑through; plant management is the company’s own responsibility.

According to the You Analysis industry database, the gross margin was 34.57% in Q1 2026, 34.71% in Q2 2026 and 34.38% in Q3 2026, all above 34%, with Q2 being the peak for the period. The chart data is current through Q3 2026.
Source: You Analysis industry database

Customers are still willing to accept price pass‑through. The company says the IC price hike is not unique to Wei Chiao – “the IC price issue is the same no matter who you ask,” and customers understand this. On the factory side, further improvements in production efficiency are needed, but the company believes current challenges can be managed.

items.title: 韋僑(6417) 醫療應用占營收升至 33%！吸血海綿客戶全數改用 RFID，搶進同業市場
items.title_en: Wei Chiao (6417) Medical Applications Rise to 33% of Revenue! All Sponge Customers Switch to RFID, Entering Competitors' Market
paras: 2026年11月13日（優分析／產業數據中心報導）⸺ 韋僑(6417-TW) 前 3 季醫療應用占營收 33%，較 2025 年的 30% 增加 3 個百分點。推升占比的因素之一是一家吸血海綿客戶：到 2026 年底，該客戶將所有以 barcode 管理的海綿改用 RFID。
轉換的理由明確：手術用的海綿留在病人體內，是醫療糾紛與保險理賠的來源，貼上 RFID 後，術前術後可以掃描確認數量，可降低海綿遺留體內的風險。公司表示，醫院與保險公司願意支付相關費用，「醫生不會因為開刀忘了把海綿放在裡面被抓去關」。
對客戶而言還有商業考量，這家公司在全美吸血海綿市場的份額大約 6%，另外 94% 由同業掌握，其中較大的是嬌生（Johnson & Johnson），導入 RFID 是這家客戶搶進該市場的方法，公司指出「他就是用他要去攻那個 94 %」；韋僑供應的正是這些海綿上的 RFID 標籤。
認證到手生意才成立醫療應用的門檻在於認證，公司指出侵入式醫材大約要 5 年、非侵入式大約 3 年，才能跟客戶一起拿到認證，「一旦拿到這個認證，這個生意就是你的生意」。吸血海綿的轉換歷經多年，2026 年底全數換完，相當於完成該應用情境的驗證。
同樣的模式正在複製到其他耗材，眼科用藥、膝關節與關節鏡的專案均在進行，難度最高的是注射針筒，天線須在射出成型時嵌入，連天線端都要特殊設計；韋僑把 RFID 微型化，才能嵌入這些耗材。

藥品應用的開發時程比醫療耗材更長，美國 FDA 的 DSCSA 要求藥品建立可互通的電子追溯，公司與制定全球商品編碼標準的 GS1 合作、與一家德國藥廠從源頭貼標。公司表示「我認為要花的時間更長」；醫療領域的 RFID 目前開發程度只有 5% 到 10%，公司引用每年已實現的營運價值 10 億至 30 億美元、未來每年潛在效益 130 億至 380 億美元，並認為這個市場的競爭者只有兩家全球大廠，分別是美國標籤與包材大廠 Avery Dennison，以及 CCL；即使僅取得十分之一，產值也很大。
醫療占比與營收公司將前 3 季營收年增 22.08% 歸因於醫療、工業與消費應用專案同步擴大，醫療占比提升期間，營收也同步增加。2026 年第 2 季 5.06 億元、第 3 季 5.10 億元，營收從 2025 年第 4 季起連四季創高，前 3 季合計 14.44 億元；毛利率也從 2025 年第 3 季的 29.35% 升到 34% 以上。
如下圖，根據優分析產業資料庫，季營收由 2025 年第 3 季的 4.05 億元升到 2026 年第 3 季的 5.10 億元，同期毛利率從 29.35% 升到 34.38%，兩項指標同步上升，圖中資料截至 2026 年第 3 季。
（資料來源：優分析產業資料庫）
醫療占比 3 個百分點的提升，部分來自一家客戶全面替換 barcode；客戶爭取的是全美吸血海綿市場其餘的 94%，韋僑的角色是供應標籤。公司已完成吸血海綿應用的驗證，注射針筒這類更難的耗材仍在認證階段，醫療占比若要進一步提高，仍須等待相關認證通過。

paras_en: On November 13, 2026 (Yoo Analysis/Industry Data Center report) – Wei Chiao (6417‑TW) reported that medical applications accounted for 33% of revenue in the first three quarters, up 3 percentage points from 30% in 2025. One driver of the increase was a sponge customer: by the end of 2026 the customer will replace all barcode‑managed sponges with RFID.

The reason for the switch is clear: surgical sponges left inside patients are a source of medical disputes and insurance claims. With RFID tags, the number of sponges can be scanned before and after surgery, reducing the risk of retained sponges. The company said hospitals and insurers are willing to pay the related costs, noting “doctors won’t be caught and jailed for forgetting a sponge inside a patient.”

The customer also has commercial motives. The firm holds about 6% of the U.S. surgical‑sponge market, while the remaining 94% is controlled by competitors, the largest being Johnson & Johnson. Introducing RFID is the customer’s way to capture that 94% share, and Wei Chiao supplies the RFID tags for those sponges.

The hurdle for medical applications is certification. The company noted that invasive medical devices typically require about five years of certification, non‑invasive about three years, before a joint certification with the customer can be obtained. “Once you get the certification, the business is yours.” The sponge conversion took several years and will be fully completed by the end of 2026, effectively validating that use case.

The same model is being replicated for other consumables. Projects for ophthalmic drugs, knee‑joint and arthroscopy supplies are underway, while the most challenging is the injection syringe, which requires the antenna to be embedded during injection molding and even the antenna tip must be specially designed. Wei Chiao has miniaturized RFID to fit these consumables.

Pharmaceutical applications have an even longer development timeline. The U.S. FDA’s DSCSA requires interoperable electronic traceability for drugs. The company is working with GS1, the global standards body for product codes, and a German pharma firm to apply labels at the source. “I think it will take even longer,” the company said. RFID development in healthcare is currently only 5%‑10% complete. The firm cites realized operational value of US$1‑3 billion per year and a future potential of US$13‑38 billion annually, noting only two global competitors – Avery Dennison and CCL – dominate the market. Even capturing one‑tenth of the market would be sizable.

The medical share and revenue increase: the company attributes a 22.08% year‑over‑year revenue growth in the first three quarters to simultaneous expansion of medical, industrial and consumer projects. As the medical share rose, revenue rose as well – NT$506 million in Q2 2026 and NT$510 million in Q3 2026, with four consecutive quarters of record revenue starting Q4 2025, totaling NT$1.444 billion for the first three quarters. Gross margin also rose from 29.35% in Q3 2025 to over 34%.

According to the chart from Yoo Analysis’ industry database, quarterly revenue grew from NT$405 million in Q3 2025 to NT$510 million in Q3 2026, while gross margin increased from 29.35% to 34.38%, with both metrics moving upward through Q3 2026.
Source: Yoo Analysis industry database

The 3‑percentage‑point rise in medical share partly stems from a single customer’s full replacement of barcodes. The customer is targeting the remaining 94% of the U.S. sponge market, and Wei Chiao’s role is to supply the tags. The sponge application has been validated; more difficult consumables such as injection syringes are still in the certification phase. Further gains in medical share will depend on those certifications being approved.

items.title: 韋僑(6417) 無電池藍牙標籤已放量！靠門市讀取器供電，2027 年服飾客戶續增出貨
paras: 2026年11月13日（優分析／產業數據中心報導）⸺ 韋僑(6417-TW) 與一家以色列的 IC 公司合作，開發出不需要電池的藍牙標籤，貼在服飾上，2026 年已在一家大型服飾公司開始放量。標籤的能量來自門市既有的讀取器（reader），公司將此產品線歸入環境物聯網（ambient IoT）。
這項產品解決了原有 RFID 的限制。公司指出，RAIN RFID 須由讀取器啟動標籤才能取得資料，屬於批次讀取，系統無法掌握消費者在店內的移動與商品位置；加上低功耗藍牙之後，標籤可以主動傳送資料，讓門市取得即時資訊。
製造是主要難點，公司表示這種標籤須在捲對捲產線上整合感測器，「你有沒有能力做捲對捲的技術」是關鍵；天線原本用 PI 材料、成本高，韋僑改用鋁天線，降低成本，客戶才願意為新增功能付費。
客戶已經在放量這家客戶從 2026 年開始放量，考量在於投資報酬，公司指出效益包括門市決策、顧客互動、陳列與銷售的優化，額外投入具有投資效益，所以「它其實已經開始在放量」。
2027 年會繼續放量，公司表示「明年這個會繼續放量」。這條產品線對韋僑的意義，是把原本做標籤的客戶關係延伸到藍牙通訊層，客戶若更換供應商，等同須一併更換捲對捲產線與測試。
公司將今年的成長歸因於工業應用客戶穩定成長、以及消費應用客戶放量出貨。服飾產品線屬於後者，是 2026 年才開始出貨的新品項；10 月的營收年增率比 8 月的高點低，增速放緩，但仍維持成長。
如下圖，根據優分析產業資料庫，月營收年增率 2026 年 3 月到 8 月維持在 22% 以上、8 月最高 34.27%，9 月與 10 月降到 18.26% 與 17.27%，圖中資料截至 2026 年 10 月。
（資料來源：優分析產業資料庫）

市場成長空間可觀，據藍牙技術聯盟與 ABI Research 估計，全球藍牙智慧標籤出貨量會由 2026 年的 1.69 億枚成長到 2031 年的 19 億枚，年複合成長率 62%。公司認為，不需要電池的這一類方案目前只有兩組，一組是 Wiliot，與美國標籤與包材大廠 Avery Dennison 合作；另一組是這家以色列 IC 公司與韋僑；至於能否掌握市場機會，公司表示設備與生產模式由公司與客戶共同開發、公司掌握關鍵技術。
有電池的版本物流應用需要另一種版本。運送途中沒有讀取器可以供電，標籤必須自備電源，韋僑花 5 年做薄膜電池，將薄型可彎電池與藍牙、溫度感測器一併整合至捲對捲產線；2026 年第 3、4 季開始出貨，2027 年雙方將朝 SoC 發展，將 IC 從多顆整合為一顆。
兩條產品線目前的進展，是服飾客戶已經放量、2027 年持續放量，以及物流客戶在 2027 年朝 SoC 發展。韋僑的競爭門檻在於捲對捲產能與鋁天線的成本結構，這兩項條件決定公司能否在其他標籤廠追上之前，將客戶留在自家產線。

items.title: 鴻海(2317) 營業利益首破千億！毛利率減 0.33 個百分點，營業利益率升至 3.83%
items.title_en: Foxconn (2317) Operating Profit Breaks 100 Billion for the First Time! Gross Margin Down 0.33 Percentage Points, Operating Profit Margin Rises to 3.83%
paras: 2026年11月13日（優分析／產業數據中心報導）⸺ 第 3 季營收 3.02 兆元、年增 46%，營業利益 1,154 億元、年增 64%，首次單季突破千億元；歸屬母公司稅後淨利 775 億元、年增 34%，每股盈餘 5.51 元。AI 伺服器帶動營運規模擴大，公司表示 AI 伺服器已成為鴻海最重要的成長動能。
雲端網路產品占第 3 季營收 54%，在四類產品中占比最高。公司表示會持續優化營收與客戶結構，並深化垂直整合，讓成長建立在更有競爭力的基礎上。

毛利率較去年同期下降 0.33 個百分點、降至 6.02%，公司歸因於產品組合與原物料價格上漲，毛利金額仍有 1,815 億元、年增 39%。同一季營業利益率反向升至 3.83%、年增 0.40 個百分點，兩項利潤率走勢分歧，關鍵在營業費用：第 3 季營業費用 661 億元是以毛利 1,815 億元減營業利益 1,154 億元推算而得，費用率 2.19%；去年同期財報上的營業費用是 602 億元，占去年第 3 季營收 2.06 兆元的 2.92%，費用只增加 9.8%，營收成長 46%。
如下圖，根據優分析產業資料庫，毛利率與營業利益率兩條線在 2026 年靠攏：毛利率大致守在 6% 一線，營業利益率從 2025 年第 1 季的不到 3% 往上，2026 年第 2 季接近 4%，兩條線的距離跟著縮小，圖只到 2026 年第 2 季。
（資料來源：優分析產業資料庫）

營業費用只增 9.8%，是行銷、管理與研發三項支出未隨營收等比例增加，公司將原因歸於業務規模擴大與營運效率提升。業外表現則拖累淨利：歸屬母公司的淨利年增 34%，比營業利益的 64% 少了 30 個百分點，差距在業外，第 3 季業外獲利 34 億元、較去年同期減少約 130 億元，投資收益減少、淨利息支出與匯兌成本增加三個方向都不利，去年同期還有資產處分利益。營業利益 1,154 億元加業外 34 億元是稅前 1,188 億元，扣除稅與非控制權益後，歸屬母公司的稅後淨利是 775 億元。
零組件自製拉高毛利金額毛利率下滑的主因是產品組合與原物料價格，自製比率提高則讓毛利金額仍年增 39%。公司表示，垂直整合的零組件金額去年約 1.3 兆元，今年增至超過 1.6 兆元，這部分的毛利率高於 15%，「我們做越多零組件，平均毛利率就會越高」。
ASIC 機櫃是垂直整合空間較大的一類。從系統架構、主板設計、電源、液冷散熱到高速連接都要客製化，客製化的重點落在零組件，這是公司把 ASIC 專案列為零組件業務成長來源的原因。自製的另一項效益是縮短交期，公司表示自製比重越高，產品從開發到量產的時間越短。

精密加工接到光通訊公司自製的機櫃零組件超過一半。精密加工是另一個環節，金屬加工能力涵蓋 5 個製造精度等級，精密模具的加工精度可達 2 微米，光學鏡頭與光通訊元件的加工精度可達小於 1 微米；下一代 AI 伺服器對光通訊晶片連接器與微光學元件的精度要求更高，這批技術成為切入 AI 關鍵零組件的基礎。公司指出，同樣的精密加工能力過去用在手機上，精度要求有限；光通訊需要在極小的範圍內精準對接多根光纖，對精度的要求高得多。
第 4 季營收預期季增、年增強勁。前 3 季營業利益率 3.73%，公司對中長期維持在 3% 以上的目標沒有改變。產品組合壓低毛利率，費用控管與自製零組件則帶動營業利益率上升，費用率同步下降。第 4 季能否延續此一獲利結構，取決於 AI 機櫃與消費智能兩類產品的出貨節奏。

paras_en: On November 13, 2026 (reported by You Analysis/Industry Data Center) the company posted Q3 revenue of NT$3.02 trillion, up 46% year‑over‑year, and operating profit of NT$115.4 billion, up 64% YoY, marking the first quarter in which operating profit exceeded NT$100 billion. Net profit attributable to the parent company was NT$77.5 billion, up 34% YoY, and earnings per share were NT$5.51. AI servers drove the expansion of operating scale, and the company said AI servers have become Foxconn’s most important growth engine.

Cloud networking products accounted for 54% of Q3 revenue, the highest share among the four product categories. The company said it will continue to optimise its revenue and customer mix and deepen vertical integration so that growth is built on a more competitive foundation.

Gross margin fell 0.33 percentage points from the same period last year to 6.02%, which the company attributes to product mix and rising raw‑material prices, but gross profit still amounted to NT$181.5 billion, up 39% YoY. In the same quarter, operating profit margin moved in the opposite direction, rising to 3.83%, an increase of 0.40 percentage points YoY. The divergence in the two profitability ratios hinges on operating expenses: Q3 operating expenses were NT$66.1 billion, derived from gross profit of NT$181.5 billion less operating profit of NT$115.4 billion, giving an expense ratio of 2.19%. In the prior‑year report, operating expenses were NT$60.2 billion, representing 2.92% of last year’s Q3 revenue of NT$2.06 trillion; expenses rose only 9.8% while revenue grew 46%.

As shown in the chart from You Analysis’ industry database, the gross‑margin and operating‑profit‑margin lines converge in 2026: gross margin stays roughly around the 6% line, while operating profit margin climbs from below 3% in Q1 2025 to near 4% in Q2 2026, narrowing the gap. The chart only goes up to Q2 2026.
Source: You Analysis industry database.

Operating expenses increased only 9.8% because marketing, administration and R&D spending did not rise proportionally with revenue; the company attributes this to larger business scale and improved operational efficiency. Non‑operating performance dragged down net profit: net profit attributable to the parent grew 34% YoY, 30 percentage points less than the 64% rise in operating profit, mainly due to non‑operating items. In Q3, non‑operating profit was NT$3.4 billion, about NT$13 billion lower than a year earlier, reflecting lower investment income, higher net interest expense and increased foreign‑exchange costs, whereas the prior year still had gains from asset disposals. Operating profit of NT$115.4 billion plus non‑operating profit of NT$3.4 billion equals pre‑tax profit of NT$118.8 billion; after taxes and non‑controlling interests, net profit attributable to the parent was NT$77.5 billion.

The decline in gross‑margin percentage is mainly due to product mix and raw‑material price increases, but the higher in‑house component ratio kept gross profit up 39% YoY. The company said vertically integrated component value was about NT$1.3 trillion last year and has risen to over NT$1.6 trillion this year, with a margin above 15%. “The more components we make ourselves, the higher the average gross margin becomes,” it added.

ASIC cabinets represent a segment with significant vertical‑integration potential. From system architecture, motherboard design, power supply, liquid‑cooling to high‑speed interconnects, everything must be customized, with the focus on components. This is why the company treats ASIC projects as a source of component‑business growth. Another benefit of in‑house production is shorter lead times; the higher the self‑manufacturing share, the faster a product moves from development to mass production.

Precision machining receives more than half of its cabinet component orders from optical‑communication companies. This capability covers five manufacturing precision grades; precision molds can be machined to 2 µm, and optical lenses and photonic components to under 1 µm. Next‑generation AI servers demand even tighter tolerances for optical‑chip connectors and micro‑optics, making these technologies the foundation for entering AI‑critical components. The company noted that the same precision‑machining capacity was previously used for smartphones, where tolerance requirements were modest; optical communication, however, requires extremely accurate alignment of multiple fibers within a very small space.

Q4 revenue is expected to grow strongly both quarter‑over‑quarter and year‑over‑year. The operating‑profit margin for the first three quarters was 3.73%, and the company has not changed its medium‑ to long‑term target of maintaining a margin above 3%. While the product mix suppresses gross margin, expense control and self‑manufactured components are driving operating‑profit‑margin improvement and a simultaneous decline in expense ratio. Whether this profit structure can be sustained in Q4 will depend on the shipment pace of AI cabinets and consumer‑intelligence products.

items.title: 鴻海(2317) EBITDA 達 3,692 億仍現資金缺口！自由現金流流出 2,874 億，存貨與應收款占用資金
items.title_en: Foxconn (2317) EBITDA Reaches NT$369.2 B Yet Still Shows Cash Shortfall! Free Cash Flow Outflows NT$287.4 B, Inventory and Receivables Tie Up Capital
paras: 2026年11月13日（優分析／產業數據中心報導）⸺ 前 3 季 EBITDA（稅前息前折舊攤銷前的獲利）3,692 億元、年增 50.3%，較去年同期增加 1,236 億元，已超過去年全年的 3,570 億元；同期資本支出 1,617 億元、年增 43%。但同期自由現金流是淨流出 2,874 億元、比去年同期多流出 1,251 億元，營業活動現金流淨流出 1,257 億元，扣除資本支出後即為上述自由現金流淨流出金額；從 EBITDA 3,692 億元到營業活動現金流淨流出 1,257 億元，中間相差 4,949 億元，稅費、利息與營運資金變動均反映在此一差距中。
公司指出，現金支出主要用於業務成長。AI 業務成長帶動應收帳款與存貨增加，加上因應未來擴張的資本支出；公司表示，「目前的現金支出是掌握 AI 基礎建設商機的必要投入」，並指出背後有 Tier 1 大型客戶的訂單與長期需求支持。AI 機櫃單價大幅提升之後，從協助客戶採購關鍵零組件、安排存貨，到完成生產與出貨，整個生產週期所需資金均須由鴻海先行支付，公司指出，增加最多的項目是應收帳款與存貨。
如下圖，根據優分析產業資料庫，投資於未來的支出項目裡，存貨金額從 2025 年第 3 季的 1.2 兆元左右攀升至 2026 年第 2 季接近 1.4 兆元，是圖上最高的一點，備貨支出早於客戶貨款回收，圖只到 2026 年第 2 季。
（資料來源：優分析產業資料庫）
公司強調，此一模式的風險並非由鴻海承擔。公司主要服務全球 Tier 1 大型企業，這些客戶的市場地位與財務實力較強，應收帳款的信用風險因此較低；採購與生產依客戶訂單與產品規格安排，存貨也透過客戶承諾或合約安排，降低公司承擔的風險。
寄售模式降低資金佔用公司也透過交易模式降低資金佔用。ASIC 專案大多採用寄售，晶片由客戶持有，成本不列在鴻海的營收與存貨，鴻海僅認列代工與組裝收入，因此 ASIC 的營收占比會低於出貨量占比。第 3 季 ASIC AI 伺服器出貨量年增 1.5 倍，高於 GPU 的 70%，公司表示這種模式有助降低營運資金佔用。
營運資金管理也反映在現金週轉天數：第 3 季含應收帳款管理工具為 40 天、比去年同期改善 3 天，排除這項工具為 48 天、也比去年同期改善 2 天。資金調度上，公司維持「以長支長，以短支短」，長期投資用長期資金，短期營運靠借款與現金周轉期管理，籌資現階段以可轉換公司債為主，兼顧幣別多元與資金成本。9 月底帳上現金與定期存款合計約 1.45 兆元，足以支應業務成長與策略投資。
全年自由現金流看第 4 季前 3 季資本支出年增 43%，前次法說會公司提出的是 30% 以上的增幅，資金主要用於 AI 相關業務的產能擴充與全球布局。另一項財務數據是 EBITDA 減去資本支出與現金股利後的餘額，公司指出這個餘額在擴大，代表本業創造的現金足以支付未來的資本支出，也能持續提高現金股利。
公司表示，2026 年全年自由現金流能否維持正數，要看第 4 季出貨及收款進度，以及資本支出的實際執行狀況。EBITDA 3,692 億元扣除資本支出 1,617 億元後尚餘 2,075 億元，這筆餘裕被稅費、利息與營運資金的占用抵銷，此一缺口即前述 4,949 億元，2,075 億元減去該缺口後為淨流出 2,874 億元；全年自由現金流能否轉正，取決於第 4 季的收款進度。

paras_en: On November 13, 2026 (U-Analysis/Industry Data Center report) – EBITDA for the first three quarters reached NT$369.2 billion, up 50.3% year‑over‑year and  NT$123.6 billion higher than the same period last year, surpassing the full‑year 2025 total of NT$357.0 billion. Capital expenditures for the same period were NT$161.7 billion, up 43% YoY. However, free cash flow was a net outflow of NT$287.4 billion,  NT$125.1 billion more than the outflow in the same period last year, with operating cash flow a net outflow of NT$125.7 billion; after deducting capex this equals the free cash flow figure. The gap between EBITDA of NT$369.2 billion and operating cash outflow of NT$125.7 billion is NT$494.9 billion, reflecting taxes, interest and changes in working capital.

The company said cash outflows are mainly for business growth. AI‑related business expansion has driven up accounts receivable and inventory, together with capital spending for future expansion. Foxconn stated that “the current cash outlays are necessary investments to capture AI infrastructure opportunities,” and highlighted backing from Tier‑1 large customers with long‑term demand. After AI server cabinet prices rose sharply, Foxconn must front the funds for everything from sourcing key components and stocking inventory to production and shipment, with receivables and inventory seeing the biggest increases.

The chart below, based on U‑Analysis’s industry database, shows that inventory rose from roughly NT$1.2 trillion in Q3 2025 to nearly NT$1.4 trillion in Q2 2026 – the highest point on the graph – indicating that stocking expenses precede customer payments. The chart only goes up to Q2 2026.
Source: U‑Analysis Industry Database

The company emphasized that this model’s risk is not borne by Foxconn. It mainly serves global Tier‑1 enterprises whose market position and financial strength are strong, so the credit risk of receivables is low. Procurement and production follow customer orders and specifications, and inventory is secured through customer commitments or contracts, further reducing Foxconn’s exposure.

The consignment model also reduces cash tied up. Most ASIC projects use consignment, with chips held by customers and not recorded as Foxconn’s revenue or inventory; Foxconn only recognizes contract manufacturing and assembly revenue, so ASIC revenue as a share of shipments appears lower. In Q3, ASIC AI server shipments grew 1.5 times year‑over‑year, outpacing GPU growth of 70%, and the company said this model helps lower working‑capital requirements.

Working‑capital management is reflected in cash conversion days: including receivable‑management tools, Q3 was 40 days, three days better than a year ago; excluding the tool, it was 48 days, two days better YoY. Foxconn maintains a “long‑term funding for long‑term investments, short‑term funding for short‑term operations” policy, using long‑term capital for investments and short‑term borrowing and cash‑cycle management for operations. Current financing relies mainly on convertible bonds, diversifying currencies and cost. As of the end of September, cash and term deposits totaled about NT$1.45 trillion, sufficient to support growth and strategic investment.

Looking at full‑year free cash flow, capital expenditures in the first three quarters grew 43% YoY, exceeding the >30% increase the company previously projected at its earnings call. The funds are mainly for AI‑related capacity expansion and global rollout. Another metric is EBITDA minus capex and cash dividends; Foxconn said this residual is expanding, indicating operating cash generation can cover future capex and sustain cash dividends.

Foxconn said whether full‑year free cash flow remains positive depends on Q4 shipment and collection progress and actual capex execution. EBITDA of NT$369.2 billion less capex of NT$161.7 billion leaves NT$207.5 billion, which is offset by taxes, interest and working‑capital usage – the gap of NT$494.9 billion mentioned earlier. Subtracting that gap from NT$207.5 billion results in a net outflow of NT$287.4 billion; the ability to turn free cash flow positive hinges on Q4 collections.

items.title: 鴻海(2317) 四類產品展望齊上調！10 月營收 1.31 兆，2026 年第 4 季僅電腦終端季減
items.title_en: Foxconn (2317) Raises Outlook for All Four Product Categories! October Revenue Hits NT$1.31 Trillion, Q4 2026 Only Computer End-User Segment Declines
paras: 2026年11月13日（優分析／產業數據中心報導）⸺ 10 月營收 1.31 兆元、年增 45.7%、月增 12.7%，創今年單月新高；累計前 10 月 8.98 兆元、年增 40.4%。公司在法說會上同步上調 2026 年四大產品的全年展望，第 4 季則預期三類產品季增，僅電腦終端季減。
如下圖，根據優分析產業資料庫，10 月營收 1.31 兆元是圖中最高的單月營收，年增率 45.7%，累計年增率 40.4% 是今年以來最高，圖只到 2026 年 10 月。
（資料來源：優分析產業資料庫）
雲端網路是第 4 季最大的動能。新一代 AI 伺服器機櫃開始出貨，公司表示隨著自動化程度提高，生產良率已達到很高的水準，新一代 AI 機櫃的市占率也比上一代提升；公司預期第 4 季 AI 機櫃出貨量維持季對季高雙位數，帶動 AI 伺服器營收持續季增、通用伺服器溫和成長，雲端網路產品季對季顯著成長、年對年強勁成長。
消費智能進入第 4 季出貨高峰，產品需求良好，出貨價格亦提高，季對季與年對年都預期強勁成長。元件及其他因主要業務相關零組件出貨增加，季對季預期顯著成長。
電腦終端是四類產品裡唯一季對季預期略微衰退的一類。記憶體等供應緊張壓抑出貨量，部分零組件價格上漲又帶動出貨價格上揚，出貨量減少與單價上升相互影響下，該類產品營收與去年同期相比仍預期顯著成長。
記憶體緊俏也出現在外部報告。調研機構 TrendForce 9 月底估計，第 4 季一般型 DRAM 合約價將季增 10% 至 15%，2027 年 PC DRAM 供給還可能因產能轉向伺服器而縮減，這是電腦終端出貨被壓抑的原因。
全年能見度優於 8 月公司表示，「目前的能見度比 8 月份法說會的時候要來得更好」，今年全年營運幾乎均高於先前預期，此一趨勢預期延續到 2027 年。第 3 季雲端網路產品占營收比重已升到 54%，是四類產品中占比最高的一類。
第 3 季 AI 機櫃出貨已達高雙位數季增，第 4 季指引顯示，這項成長速度可望延續。10 月單月 1.31 兆元已高於第 3 季的單月平均：第 3 季營收 3.02 兆元換算每月約 1.01 兆元。依這個基準，11 月與 12 月合計 1.71 兆元僅能與第 3 季持平，換算平均每月約 0.86 兆元，仍低於 10 月單月；第 4 季要優於第 3 季，這兩個月合計營收須超過此一持平門檻。
第 4 季季增動能來自三類產品，電腦終端受記憶體供需影響而季減、與去年同期相比仍成長；全年展望則是在 8 月的基礎上四類同步上調。

paras_en: On November 13, 2026 (U-Analysis/Industry Data Center report) – October revenue reached NT$1.31 trillion, up 45.7% year‑over‑year and 12.7% month‑over‑month, setting a new monthly high for the year; cumulative revenue for the first ten months was NT$8.98 trillion, up 40.4% year‑over‑year. In its earnings briefing, the company simultaneously raised its full‑year outlook for its four major product lines in 2026, forecasting quarter‑over‑quarter growth for three categories in Q4, with only the computer end‑user segment expected to decline.

According to the chart from U‑Analysis’s industry database, the NT$1.31 trillion recorded in October is the highest single‑month revenue shown, with a 45.7% YoY increase; the cumulative YoY growth of 40.4% is the strongest this year, and the chart only goes up to October 2026.
Source: U‑Analysis industry database

Cloud networking is the biggest driver in Q4. The next‑generation AI server racks have started shipping, and the company says that as automation improves, production yields have reached a very high level and the market share of the new‑gen AI racks has risen compared with the previous generation. The company expects AI rack shipments in Q4 to maintain a high double‑digit quarter‑over‑quarter increase, driving continued quarterly growth in AI server revenue, modest growth in general‑purpose servers, and significant quarter‑over‑quarter and strong year‑over‑year growth for cloud networking products.

Consumer smart devices enter a Q4 shipment peak, with strong product demand and higher shipment prices, leading to robust quarter‑over‑quarter and year‑over‑year growth expectations. Components and other items also see a notable quarter‑over‑quarter increase due to higher shipments of key‑related parts.

Computer end‑user products are the only of the four categories expected to see a slight quarter‑over‑quarter decline. Tight memory supply suppresses shipment volumes, while price hikes for some components push up shipment prices. The interaction of lower volumes and higher prices means that, despite the decline in units, revenue for this segment is still expected to grow significantly versus the same period last year.

Memory tightness is also noted in external reports. Research firm TrendForce estimated at the end of September that contract prices for standard‑type DRAM in Q4 would rise 10%‑15% quarter‑over‑quarter, and that PC DRAM supply in 2027 could shrink further as capacity shifts to servers, which is a key reason for the constrained computer end‑user shipments.

Full‑year visibility is better than in August, the company said, “Our visibility is now better than it was at the August earnings briefing.” Almost all of this year’s operating performance has exceeded prior expectations, and the trend is expected to continue into 2027. In Q3, cloud networking products accounted for 54% of revenue, the highest share among the four product categories.

AI rack shipments in Q3 already achieved a high double‑digit quarter‑over‑quarter increase, and the guidance for Q4 indicates this growth rate should continue. October’s single‑month revenue of NT$1.31 trillion already exceeds the Q3 monthly average (Q3 revenue of NT$3.02 trillion translates to about NT$1.01 trillion per month). Based on this benchmark, the combined revenue for November and December would need to reach NT$1.71 trillion to merely match Q3, averaging about NT$0.86 trillion per month, which is still below October’s level; to outperform Q3, the two months must together exceed this breakeven point.

The Q4 quarter‑over‑quarter momentum comes from three product categories; computer end‑user products are expected to decline quarter‑over‑quarter due to memory supply‑demand dynamics but will still grow versus the same period last year. The full‑year outlook has been raised across all four categories compared with the August baseline.

items.title: 鴻海(2317) 2027 年 AI 機櫃估高雙位數成長！九大 CSP 資本支出拚 1.5 兆美元，供給仍是限制
items.title_en: Foxconn (2317) Projects Double‑Digit Growth for 2027 AI Racks; Top 9 CSP Capex Targets $1.5 Trillion, Supply Remains a Constraint
paras: 2026年11月13日（優分析／產業數據中心報導）⸺ 公司預估 2027 年 AI 機櫃出貨量高雙位數成長、新一代機櫃的市佔率進一步提升，集團 2027 年營運維持雙位數成長。此前，第 4 季 AI 機櫃出貨量先維持季對季高雙位數。
如下圖，根據優分析產業資料庫，2027 年營收的法人預估線今年上移，明顯高於 2026 年的預估線，兩條預估線的差距近半年擴大；末端數個資料點仍有波動，圖上最後一個資料點是 2026 年 11 月。
（資料來源：優分析產業資料庫）
這項出貨預估以訂單與客戶需求為依據。公司表示，「我們仍然有信心 2027 年 AI 機櫃出貨可以維持高雙位數的成長」，主要雲端服務供應商會持續擴大 AI 投資，目前還在快速擴張階段；大型 CSP 仍是最主要客戶，2027 年將增加更多新興的 AI 算力供應商（業界稱 Neocloud），有助進一步提升 AI 伺服器的市佔率。
外部估算的方向一致。調研機構 TrendForce 10 月中預估，全球前九大 CSP 2026 年資本支出總額逾 9,570 億美元、年增 106%，2027 年突破 1.5 兆美元、年增 60%。兩年都優於先前預期，其中 2027 年的年增幅度是從 50% 上調到 60%；同一份估算認為 2027 年 AI 伺服器出貨量年增近 36%。
法人對鴻海 2027 年營收的平均預估亦上修。取近三個月各家法人報告的平均，8 月下旬是 13.87 兆元，11 月 11 日為 14.36 兆元，上修 3.5%；同期間 2026 年的平均預估僅從 10.82 兆元升至 10.93 兆元，上修 1.0%，上修的幅度集中在 2027 年。
供給吃緊是限制項公司提醒的變數落在供給端。公司表示，「目前在晶片、記憶體以及部分關鍵零組件供應吃緊」，隨著新產能陸續開出，瓶頸會逐漸緩解，但 2027 年整體需求預期仍大於供給，吃緊可能持續一段時間。

上季 ASIC 出貨快於 GPU需求結構的變化反映在 ASIC 與 GPU 的出貨增速上。第 3 季 ASIC AI 伺服器出貨量年增 1.5 倍，高於 GPU 的 70%；公司認為 2027 年兩者都會成長，GPU 在大型模型訓練與通用運算仍是主流，ASIC 隨著推論與 AI Agent 應用增加，成長速度有機會更快。公司引用調研機構的估計，ASIC AI 伺服器出貨占比將從 2026 年的 27.8% 升到 2030 年的 40%。ASIC 專案多採寄售模式，晶片成本不在鴻海，出貨量的成長不會等比例反映在營收上。
雲端網路占比往六成產品組合變化直接反映在營收占比，雲端網路已是占比最高的一類。第 3 季雲端網路產品占營收 54%，公司預期未來 3 到 5 年占比會提高到 6 成以上。
其餘三類的方向不同。消費智能因主要客戶產品以高階為主，受記憶體等供應鏈短缺影響有限，2027 年整體表現預期相對穩定；公司對 PC 的看法相對審慎，記憶體供應緊張與零組件價格上漲可能影響終端售價與消費者換機意願；電動車因客戶海外專案陸續進入量產、新車型開始商業化，相關營收預期持續成長。
總體環境的假設是 K 型發展，AI 相關產業成長，其他 ICT 產品則下滑。公司引用 IMF 的估計，2027 年全球經濟成長率 3.4%、高於今年的 3.1%，AI 相關產業受惠算力需求而成長強勁，其他 ICT 產品受記憶體與零組件成本影響，表現分歧。
公司表示，「AI 是最重要的成長引擎，ICT 則會是有穩健的表現」。2027 年 AI 機櫃的高雙位數成長建立在客戶已下的訂單與算力投資上，同期仍須面對晶片與記憶體的供給限制。

paras_en: November 13, 2026 (U-Analysis/Industry Data Center report) – The company forecasts double‑digit growth in AI rack shipments for 2027 and a further rise in market share for next‑generation racks, with group operating revenue also expected to grow at double‑digit rates in 2027. In the fourth quarter, AI rack shipments already showed a quarter‑over‑quarter high‑double‑digit increase.

The chart below, based on U‑Analysis’s industry database, shows the corporate revenue forecast line for 2027 shifting upward this year, clearly above the 2026 forecast line, with the gap between the two lines widening by nearly six months; the last few data points at the tail end still fluctuate, and the final point on the chart is November 2026.
Source: U‑Analysis industry database

The shipment outlook is based on orders and customer demand. The company says, “We remain confident that AI rack shipments can sustain high double‑digit growth in 2027.” Major cloud service providers will continue to expand AI investments, which are still in a rapid expansion phase; large CSPs remain the primary customers, and 2027 will see more emerging AI compute providers (referred to in the industry as Neocloud), helping to further boost AI server market share.

External estimates align. Research firm TrendForce projected in mid‑October that the total capital expenditure of the world’s top nine CSPs will exceed $957 billion in 2026, a 106% year‑over‑year increase, and will break $1.5 trillion in 2027, a 60% increase. Both years exceed prior expectations, with the 2027 growth rate revised up from 50% to 60%; the same estimate predicts AI server shipments will grow about 36% year‑over‑year in 2027.

Institutional analysts also raised their average revenue forecasts for Foxconn in 2027. Averaging reports from the past three months, the estimate was NT$13.87 trillion in late August and NT$14.36 trillion on November 11, a 3.5% upward revision. For 2026, the average estimate rose only from NT$10.82 trillion to NT$10.93 trillion, a 1.0% increase, with most of the upward adjustment concentrated in 2027.

Supply constraints are a noted limiting factor. The company says, “Currently chip, memory and some key component supplies are tight.” As new capacity comes online, bottlenecks will gradually ease, but overall demand in 2027 is still expected to outpace supply, so tightness may persist for some time.

Last quarter’s faster ASIC shipments relative to GPU demand are reflected in their respective growth rates. In Q3, ASIC AI server shipments grew 1.5 times year‑over‑year, outpacing GPU growth of 70%. The company expects both to grow in 2027, with GPUs remaining mainstream for large‑model training and general computing, while ASICs could grow faster as inference and AI‑Agent applications expand. Research estimates ASIC AI server shipments will rise from 27.8% of total in 2026 to 40% by 2030. ASIC projects are often on a consignment basis, with chip costs not borne by Foxconn, so shipment growth will not translate proportionally to revenue.

Cloud networking’s share of the product mix, now around 60%, directly translates to its revenue share, making it the largest category. In Q3, cloud networking accounted for 54% of revenue, and the company expects this proportion to rise above 60% over the next three to five years.

The other three categories follow different trajectories. Consumer smart devices, driven by high‑end products from major customers, are less affected by memory shortages, so 2027 performance is expected to be relatively stable. The company takes a more cautious view on PCs, as tight memory supply and rising component prices could affect end‑user pricing and upgrade intent. Electric‑vehicle revenue should keep growing as overseas customer projects move into mass production and new models enter commercialization.

The overall scenario assumes a “K‑shaped” development: AI‑related industries grow while other ICT products decline. Citing IMF estimates, global economic growth is projected at 3.4% in 2027, up from 3.1% this year, with AI‑related sectors benefiting strongly from compute demand, whereas other ICT segments face headwinds from memory and component cost pressures, leading to divergent performance.

The company states, “AI is the most important growth engine, and ICT will deliver steady performance.” The high double‑digit growth of AI racks in 2027 is built on existing orders and compute investments, but the company will still need to contend with chip and memory supply constraints during the same period.

items.title: 金像電(2368) 漲價轉嫁原物料成本！第 3 季毛利率 38.7%，AI 伺服器占營收過半
items.title_en: Kingboard Electronics (2368) Passes Raw Material Cost Increases to Customers; Q3 Gross Margin 38.7%, AI Servers Account for Over Half of Revenue
paras: 2026年11月13日（優分析／產業數據中心報導）⸺ 金像電(2368-TW) 第 3 季毛利率 38.7%，較第 2 季的 34.7% 增加約 4 個百分點，創 2016 年以來單季新高。公司將原因歸於產品組合調整與售價提高。
AI 伺服器占營收過半第 3 季各應用占營收比重為伺服器 77%、網通 17%、筆電 3%、其他 3%，均以第 3 季營收為分母。AI 伺服器屬於伺服器應用，公司表示第 3 季占總營收超過 5 成。
高階伺服器與網通、IC 測試板位於公司層別能力的最高級距，一般伺服器板則低一階。公司表示，目前最高可達 56 層，產品線涵蓋多層板、HDI 板、厚銅板與背板。
毛利率走勢與產品組合變化相符：第 1 季 34.81%、第 2 季 34.7%，兩季幾乎持平，第 3 季升至 38.7%，同季 AI 伺服器占總營收比重也超過 5 成。
38.7% 的兩個推力毛利率提升的兩項推力為產品組合與售價。產品組合方面，AI 伺服器占總營收超過 5 成，「所以產品組合優化」；售價方面，則是原物料上漲後與客戶協商達成的調價。原物料上漲帶來成本壓力，公司表示「客人也同意我們漲價」。

近 3 個月 6 家法人的 10 份報告，對 2026 年全年毛利率的預估為 35.2% 到 37.3%，均低於第 3 季單季的 38.7%；全年預估低於單季，是因為第 1 季與第 2 季毛利率仍在 34% 上下，前 3 季累計因此為 36.33%。第 3 季毛利率由產品組合與售價共同推升，前者反映 AI 伺服器占營收比重，後者則是原物料上漲後與客戶協商達成的調價，藉此轉嫁成本增幅。公司表示，2027 年老客戶的 AI 伺服器新產品將陸續量產。
如下圖，根據優分析產業資料庫，第 3 季實際毛利率 38.7% 較法人共識高 1.3 個百分點，為 2026 年已公布的三季中超出共識幅度最大的一季。
（資料來源：優分析產業資料庫）

paras_en: On November 13, 2026 (U-Analysis/Industry Data Center report) – Kingboard Electronics (2368-TW) posted a Q3 gross margin of 38.7%, up about 4 percentage points from the 34.7% recorded in Q2, marking a single‑quarter high since 2016. The company attributes the improvement to a shift in product mix and higher selling prices.

AI servers accounted for more than half of total revenue in Q3. The revenue breakdown by application in Q3 was: servers 77%, networking 17%, laptops 3%, and others 3%, all calculated on Q3 revenue. Since AI servers are classified under the server category, they represented over 50% of total sales.

High‑end servers, networking products, and IC test boards belong to the company's highest‑tier capability level, while standard server boards are one tier lower. The company says it can now produce boards up to 56 layers, covering multi‑layer, HDI, thick‑copper, and back‑plane products.
The gross‑margin trend matches the product‑mix shift: Q1 34.81%, Q2 34.7% (almost flat), and Q3 rising to 38.7%, with AI servers also exceeding 50% of total revenue in the same quarter.

Two drivers lifted the margin to 38.7%: product mix and pricing. On the mix side, AI servers made up more than half of revenue, "optimizing the product mix"; on the pricing side, the company negotiated price hikes with customers after raw‑material costs rose, noting that "customers also agreed to our price increase."

In the past three months, ten reports from six institutions forecast a full‑year 2026 gross margin of 35.2% to 37.3%, all below the 38.7% achieved in Q3. The lower full‑year estimate reflects Q1 and Q2 margins staying around 34%, resulting in a cumulative 36.33% for the first three quarters. The Q3 margin was boosted by both product mix and price adjustments, the former reflecting the AI‑server revenue share and the latter passing on higher raw‑material costs. The company says new AI‑server products for existing customers will begin mass production in 2027.

As shown in the chart from U‑Analysis's industry database, the actual Q3 gross margin of 38.7% was 1.3 percentage points above the consensus of analysts, making it the quarter with the largest positive deviation from consensus among the three quarters reported in 2026.
Source: U‑Analysis Industry Database.
